en.headline: KMB and LWB add Golden Week trips and half-price visitor pass
en.dek: Children ride free on National Day across more than 480 routes, while extra buses are planned for borders, the airport and countryside links.
body: Kowloon Motor Bus and Long Win Bus said on Wednesday they would add services and discounts over the National Day Golden Week as visitor numbers rise.

Children may ride more than 480 KMB and LWB routes free on 1 October with an Octopus card, the companies said. From now until 11 October, visitors can buy a day pass at HK$27.5 — half the usual HK$55 — for unlimited travel for 24 hours on those routes plus the Lok Ma Chau–Huanggang shuttle, with a short list of sightseeing and K-prefixed routes excluded.

Extra trips are planned on countryside route 289R between Sha Tin and Wong Shek Pier, on B1 serving the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control point, and on W4 between West Kowloon Station, the cultural district and Tsim Sha Tsui. LWB A routes to the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge will add hundreds of trips. The HK1 open-top sightseeing service will start its shorter loop from 1.45pm.

KMB also said it would introduce three routes for the Huanggang Port once 24-hour clearance begins: B10 from Kwai Fong, B11 from Tin Shui Wai and overnight NB73 from Sha Tin, with peak intervals of about five minutes. It has applied to the Transport Department for interchange concessions so passengers paying with Octopus or e-payment would be charged only the higher of two connecting KMB or LWB fares.

zh.headline: 九巴龍運黃金周加開班次 旅客日票半價
zh.dek: 國慶日兒童可免費乘搭超過480條路線；口岸、高鐵站及郊遊路線將加開，皇崗口岸亦擁新線。
body: 九龍巴士及龍運巴士星期三表示，因應國慶黃金周旅客增加，將推出乘車優惠並加強多條路線服務。
兩家公司指，兒童於10月1日憑八達通可免費乘搭超過480條九巴及龍運路線。即日起至10月11日，旅客可以27.5元（原價55元）購買旅客日票，啟動後24小時內無限次乘搭該等路線及落馬洲至皇崗穿梭巴士，但不包括部分觀光及K字頭路線。
公司將加開沙田至西貢黃石碼頭289R線、落馬洲支線管制站B1線，以及西九龍站往西九文化區及尖沙咀的W4線。龍運港珠澳大橋A線合共加開數百班次。開篷觀光巴士HK1精選遊會提早至下午1時45分開出。
九巴亦指，皇崗口岸24小時通關後將開辦葺芳B10、天水圍B11及沙田通宵NB73三條路線，最繁忙時段約五分鐘一班。公司已向運輸署申請轉乘優惠，乘客以八達通或電子支付轉乘九巴或龍運路線往返新口岸，兩程車資只須繳付較高一程。
